The total number of people visiting Mall A on Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Sunday is what percentage of the total number of people visiting Mall B on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday? Express your answer correct to one place of decimal.

**Calculations:**

Total people visiting Mall A on Monday, Tuesday, Friday and Sunday = 560 + 700 + 840 + 1500 = 3600

Total people visiting Mall B on Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday = 700 + 750 + 1100 + 1350 = 3900

Percentage of people visiting Mall on A compared to Mall B = 3600over 3900 × 100 = 92.3%

**The answer is 92.3%.**
